national_questions.qe: For which Olympic year is the accelerated talent identification programme being planned by the Sports Authority of India?
national_questions.qh: किस वर्ष के लिए भारत में ओलंपिक प्रतिभा पहचान को तेज करने की योजना बनाई गई है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the SAI Governing Body meeting explicitly targeted the 2036 Olympic Games for building a robust athlete pool.
• Option A is Incorrect; 2028 is the Los Angeles Olympics, not the focus of the current plan.
• Option B is Incorrect; 2032 refers to the Brisbane Olympics, which is not mentioned.

national_questions.qe: Who is the chairperson of the five‑member High‑Powered Enquiry Committee constituted by the Supreme Court to probe student protest violence?
national_questions.qh: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने छात्र विरोध हिंसा की जांच के लिए गठित पाँच सदस्यीय हाई‑पॉवर्ड एन्क्वायरी कमेटी के अध्यक्ष कौन हैं?
national_questions.e:

national_questions.qe: According to the Delhi Master Plan 2047, what is the projected population of Delhi by the year 2047?
national_questions.qh: दिल्ली मास्टर प्लान 2047 के अनुसार, वर्ष 2047 तक दिल्ली की अनुमानित जनसंख्या क्या होगी?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Delhi Master Plan 2047 envisions a population of about 3.2 crore (32 million) for the national capital by 2047.
• Option A is Incorrect because the plan does not target 2.5 crore.
• Option C is Incorrect as 4.0 crore exceeds the stated projection.
• Option D is Incorrect; 5.0 crore is far beyond the plan’s estimate.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of India's first mini electric passenger aircraft series being developed by AlphaX Aerospace?
national_questions.qh: अल्फाX एयरोस्पेस द्वारा विकसित भारत की पहली मिनी इलेक्ट्रिक पेसेंजर एयरोप्लेन श्रृंखला का नाम क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the aircraft series is named **SkyRover**, a VTOL‑capable mini electric passenger aircraft with 800 km range.
• Option A is Incorrect; AeroLite is not the name announced.
• Option B is Incorrect; SkyWing refers to a different concept.
• Option D is Incorrect; AeroJet is unrelated to this project.

national_questions.qe: In the Delhi High Court judgment on generative AI, which provision of the Indian Copyright Act was clarified?
national_questions.qh: दिल्ली हाई कोर्ट के जनरेटिव एआई संबंधी फैसले में भारतीय कॉपीराइट अधिनियम की कौन सी धारा स्पष्ट की गई?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the judgment interpreted **Section 52(1)(a)** of the Copyright Act, dealing with fair dealing and the scope of copyright for AI‑generated content.
• Option A is Incorrect; Section 14 deals with registration, not AI.
• Option B is Incorrect; Section 31 concerns infringement remedies.
• Option C is Incorrect; Section 45 pertains to moral rights, unrelated to the AI issue.

national_questions.qe: When is the Mumbai‑Ahmedabad high‑speed rail corridor expected to become operational?
national_questions.qh: मुंबई‑अहमदाबाद हाई‑स्पीड रेल कॉरिडोर के संचालन की अपेक्षित तिथि कब है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the 508 km Mumbai‑Ahmedabad bullet‑train corridor, built by NHSRCL, is slated to start commercial operations in **2029**.
• Option B is Incorrect; 2030 is beyond the announced target.
• Option C is Incorrect; 2032 is not mentioned in official timelines.
• Option D is Incorrect; 2035 is far later than the projected date.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry is the nodal agency for the Guide to Grasslands and Other Open Natural Ecosystems launched on 17 August 2026?
national_questions.qh: 17 अगस्त 2026 को लॉन्च किए गए घास के मैदानों और खुले प्राकृतिक पारिस्थितिक तंत्र गाइड के लिए कौन सा मंत्रालय नोडल एजेंसी है?
oe: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
oh: पर्यावरण, वन और जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय
गृह एवं शहरी मामलों का मंत्रालय
national_questions.e: • Option A is Correct because the guide is a national publication under the Wildlife Protection Act, Environment Protection Act and the National Biodiversity Action Plan and is administered by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change. • Option B is Incorrect because agriculture ministry does not oversee wildlife‑grassland policy. • Option C is Incorrect because rural development deals with poverty‑alleviation programmes, not ecosystem guidelines. • Option D is Incorrect because housing ministry is unrelated to biodiversity management.

national_questions.qe: Under which scheme were India's first domestic manufacturing of critical electronic components approved?
national_questions.qh: भारत में महत्वपूर्ण इलेक्ट्रॉनिक घटकों के प्रथम घरेलू निर्माण को किस योजना के तहत मंजूरी मिली?
oe: Scheme for Promotion of Manufacturing of Electronic Components (SPMEC)
oh: इलेक्ट्रॉनिक घटकों के निर्माण को बढ़ावा देने की योजना (SPMEC)
national_questions.e: • Option B is Correct because the approvals for filters, coils, speakers, acetylene black and electrolyte additives were given under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS) of MeitY. • Option A is Incorrect as PLI scheme targets sectors like telecom, pharma, not component‑level approvals. • Option C is Incorrect; SPMEC is not an existing central scheme. • Option D is Incorrect; the National Electronics Mission is a broader policy, not the specific approval mechanism.

national_questions.qe: In which city is India’s first Vande Bharat sleeper‑train maintenance depot being set up?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला वंदे भारत स्लीपर ट्रेन रखरखाव डिपो किस शहर में स्थापित किया जा रहा है?
national_questions.e: • Option C is Correct because the depot dedicated to Vande Bharat sleeper trains is being constructed in Jodhpur under a joint venture with a Russian technology partner. • Option A is Incorrect; Bhopal hosts other railway projects but not this depot. • Option B is Incorrect; Surat is not mentioned in the announcement. • Option D is Incorrect; Patna is unrelated to the Vande Bharat sleeper depot.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian state is establishing the country’s first government‑owned AI university?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा भारतीय राज्य देश का पहला सरकारी‑स्वामित्व वाला एआई विश्वविद्यालय स्थापित कर रहा है?
national_questions.e: • Option D is Correct because Karnataka announced the creation of India’s first government‑owned AI university in Bengaluru. • Option A is Incorrect; Maharashtra has AI initiatives but not the first government university. • Option B is Incorrect; Tamil Nadu’s AI efforts are private‑sector driven. • Option C is Incorrect; West Bengal has AI labs but no dedicated government university yet.

national_questions.qe: Which country became the fourth nation to achieve a successful lunar landing with the Chandrayaan‑3 mission?
national_questions.qh: चंद्रयान‑3 मिशन के सफल लैंडिंग के साथ कौन सा देश चौथा राष्ट्र बना जिसने चंद्रमा पर लैंडिंग हासिल की?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Chandrayaan‑3 landed on the Moon in 2023, making India the fourth country after the United States, Russia and China to achieve a soft lunar landing.
• Option A is Incorrect because the United States achieved its first lunar landing in 1969 (Apollo 11).
• Option C is Incorrect because Russia (formerly USSR) achieved its first lunar landing in 1970 (Luna 16).
• Option D is Incorrect because China’s first lunar landing was in 2013 (Chang'e 3).

national_questions.qe: In which year was India's first satellite Aryabhata launched?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला उपग्रह आर्यभट्ट किस वर्ष लॉन्च किया गया था?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Aryabhata was launched on 19 April 1975 from the Kapustin Yar launch site in the USSR.
• Option A is Incorrect; 1972 saw no Indian satellite launch.
• Option B is Incorrect; the launch occurred a year later.
• Option D is Incorrect; the launch took place two years earlier.

national_questions.qe: In which city will India's first government‑owned AI university be established?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला सरकारी‑स्वामित्व वाला एआई विश्वविद्यालय किस शहर में स्थापित होगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Karnataka government announced that the AI university will be set up in Bengaluru.
• Option A is Incorrect; Mumbai has no such announcement.
• Option B is Incorrect; Hyderabad is not the chosen location.
• Option C is Incorrect; Chennai is unrelated to this AI university project.

national_questions.qe: What is the total payload capacity (in tonnes) of India's first Vande Bharat freight train?
national_questions.qh: भारत के पहले वंदे भारत फ्रेट ट्रेन की कुल पेलोड क्षमता (टन में) क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because official specifications state the prototype can carry up to 395 tonnes of cargo.
• Option B is Incorrect; 300 tonnes is lower than the certified capacity.
• Option C is Incorrect; 250 tonnes is not the declared figure.
• Option D is Incorrect; 420 tonnes exceeds the current design limit.

national_questions.qe: Which international body designated Parichha Weir as India's first World Heritage Irrigation Structure?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा अंतर्राष्ट्रीय निकाय परिछा बांध को भारत का पहला विश्व धरोहर सिंचाई संरचना के रूप में मान्यता देता है?
oe: International Commission on Irrigation and Drainage (ICID)
oh: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सिंचाई एवं जल निकासी आयोग (ICID)
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the International Commission on Irrigation and Drainage (ICID) conferred the World Heritage Irrigation Structure (WHIS) status on Parichha Weir, making it the first such designation in India.
• Option A is Incorrect because UNESCO grants World Heritage Site status, not the specific WHIS category.
• Option C is Incorrect as the World Bank does not award heritage designations.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Indian Council of Historical Research deals with historical research, not irrigation heritage.

national_questions.qe: By which year does Punjab Police plan to extend the Sadak Surakhya Force coverage to 6,000 km of state roads?
national_questions.qh: पंजाब पुलिस कब तक सड़क सुरक्षा बल (Sadak Surakhya Force) की कवरेज को 6,000 किमी तक बढ़ाने की योजना बना रही है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Punjab Police's roadmap states that by 2047 the Sadak Surakhya Force will cover 6,000 km of state roads, creating a 3D policing ecosystem.
• Option A is Incorrect; 2035 is earlier than the announced target.
• Option B is Incorrect; 2040 is not the stated year.
• Option D is Incorrect; 2050 exceeds the planned timeline.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian private company developed the country's first privately built orbital rocket named Vikram‑1?
national_questions.qh: विक्रम‑1 नामक भारत का पहला निजी निर्मित कक्षा रॉकेट किस भारतीय निजी कंपनी ने विकसित किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Skyroot Aerospace, based in Hyderabad, successfully developed Vikram‑1, marking India's first privately built orbital launch vehicle.
• Option B is Incorrect; Team Indus focuses on lunar missions, not orbital rockets.
• Option C is Incorrect; Bellatrix Aerospace works on propulsion systems but has not launched an orbital rocket.
• Option D is Incorrect; Agnikul Cosmos is developing a small launch vehicle, not Vikram‑1.

national_questions.qe: What percentage of V.O.C. Port's total electricity consumption was met by renewable energy in the 2025‑26 financial year?
national_questions.qh: 2025‑26 वित्तीय वर्ष में V.O.C. पोर्ट की कुल विद्युत खपत का कितना प्रतिशत नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा द्वारा पूरा किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because V.O.C. Port reported that renewable sources supplied 93.89% of its electricity consumption in FY 2025‑26, earning it Scope‑2 emission‑free status.
• Option A is Incorrect; 85.5% is lower than the actual figure.
• Option B is Incorrect; 90.2% does not match the reported value.
• Option C is Incorrect; 97.1% exceeds the documented percentage.

national_questions.qe: India signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for bilateral cooperation in telecommunications and Information and Communications Technologies (ICTs) with which country on the sidelines of the 12th BRICS Communications Ministers Meeting?
national_questions.qh: 12वीं ब्रिक्स (BRICS) संचार मंत्रियों की बैठक के दौरान भारत ने दूरसंचार और सूचना एवं संचार प्रौद्योगिकी (ICT) क्षेत्र में सहयोग हेतु किस देश के साथ समझौता ज्ञापन पर हस्ताक्षर किए?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because India and Brazil signed the MoU during the 12th BRICS Communications Ministers Meeting in Pune to cooperate on Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), cybersecurity, and telecom networks.
• Option A is Incorrect because Russia did not sign this specific bilateral ICT MoU with India at the meeting.
• Option B is Incorrect because South Africa is a BRICS member but was not the bilateral signatory for this telecom agreement.
• Option D is Incorrect because UAE is a new BRICS member but was not the partner country for this bilateral telecom MoU.

national_questions.qe: Through which Constitutional Amendment Act was the Manipuri language included in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution of India in 1992?
national_questions.qh: किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम के माध्यम से 1992 में मणिपुरी भाषा को भारत के संविधान की आठवीं अनुसूची में शामिल किया गया था?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the 71st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 added Manipuri, Konkani, and Nepali to the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution on August 20, 1992.
• Option A is Incorrect because the 21st Amendment Act, 1967 added Sindhi as the 15th regional language.
• Option B is Incorrect because the 52nd Amendment Act, 1985 introduced anti-defection provisions (Tenth Schedule).
• Option C is Incorrect because the 61st Amendment Act, 1988 reduced the voting age from 21 to 18 years.

national_questions.qe: Which company is setting up India's first large‑scale biopolymer plant at Kumbhi, Lakhimpur Kheri, Uttar Pradesh, slated for commissioning in October 2026?
national_questions.qh: कौन सी कंपनी उत्तर प्रदेश के लखीमपुर खेरी के कुंबही में अक्टूबर 2026 में कमिशनिंग के लिए भारत का पहला बड़े पैमाने का बायोपॉलिमर प्लांट स्थापित कर रही है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Balrampur Chini Mills Ltd. is developing the 3,080 crore biopolymer plant that will convert sugarcane into polylactic acid (PLA) at its Kumbhi unit, Lakhimpur Kheri, Uttar Pradesh, with commissioning expected in October 2026.
• Option B is Incorrect because Indian Oil Corporation is not involved in this biopolymer project.
• Option C is Incorrect because Hindustan Unilever does not have a biopolymer plant at this location.
• Option D is Incorrect because Tata Chemicals is not the developer of the plant.

national_questions.qe: The 1‑MW green hydrogen plant showcased at the Kandla Green Hydrogen Conclave 2026 is located in which Indian state?
national_questions.qh: 2026 के कांडला ग्रीन हाइड्रोजन कॉन्क्लेव में प्रदर्शित 1 मेगावॉट ग्रीन हाइड्रोजन प्लांट किस भारतीय राज्य में स्थित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Make‑in‑India 1‑MW green hydrogen plant is situated at DPA Kandla, Gandhidham, which is in Gujarat.
• Option A is Incorrect as Maharashtra does not host this plant.
• Option C is Incorrect because Rajasthan is not the location of the plant.
• Option D is Incorrect; Tamil Nadu is unrelated to this project.

national_questions.qe: The National Common Mobility Card (NCMC) smartcards for state transport concession passengers were first deployed across which Indian state?
national_questions.qh: राज्य परिवहन रियायत यात्रियों के लिए राष्ट्रीय सामान्य गतिशीलता कार्ड (NCMC) स्मार्टकार्ड पहली बार किस भारतीय राज्य में लागू किए गए?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the first nationwide rollout of NCMC smartcards for concession passengers covered 16,000 villages in Maharashtra through MSRTC.
• Option A is Incorrect; Karnataka was not the pilot state.
• Option B is Incorrect; Kerala did not host the initial deployment.
• Option D is Incorrect; West Bengal was not involved in this rollout.

national_questions.qe: Under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS), the total approved investment after clearance of 31 additional projects crossed which amount?
national_questions.qh: इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स कॉम्पोनेंट मैन्युफैक्चरिंग स्कीम (ECMS) के तहत 31 अतिरिक्त परियोजनाओं की मंजूरी के बाद कुल स्वीकृत निवेश किस राशि से अधिक हो गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because after the Centre cleared 31 more ECMS projects, the cumulative approved investment rose to over Rs 69,500 crore.
• Option A is Incorrect; the investment figure is lower than the actual amount.
• Option B is Incorrect; Rs 62,000 crore does not reflect the latest total.
• Option C is Incorrect; Rs 66,000 crore is still short of the reported Rs 69,500 crore.

national_questions.qe: On which date was India’s first lunar probe Chandrayaan‑1 launched?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला चंद्रयान‑1 प्रॉब किस तिथि को लॉन्च किया गया था?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Chandrayaan‑1 was launched on 22 October 2008 aboard PSLV‑C11.
• Option B is Incorrect; the launch did not occur in 2009.
• Option C is Incorrect; 5 August 2008 is not the launch date.
• Option D is Incorrect; 30 December 2008 is unrelated to the mission.

national_questions.qe: Which launch vehicle placed India’s first dedicated multi‑wavelength space observatory AstroSat into orbit?
national_questions.qh: भारत के पहले समर्पित मल्टी‑वेवलेंथ स्पेस ऑब्ज़र्वेटरी एस्ट्रोसैट को किस लॉन्च वैहिकल ने कक्षा में स्थापित किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because AstroSat was launched on 28 September 2015 aboard PSLV‑C30.
• Option A is Incorrect; GSLV Mk III was used for later missions like Chandrayaan‑3.
• Option B is Incorrect; PSLV‑C25 launched the IRNSS‑1A satellite.
• Option D is Incorrect; GSLV‑Mk II was not the launch vehicle for AstroSat.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian state was the first to introduce a QR‑code based real‑time food‑safety complaint system in hotels and pharmacies?
national_questions.qh: होटलों और फार्मेसियों में वास्तविक‑समय खाद्य‑सुरक्षा शिकायत प्रणाली के लिए QR‑कोड लागू करने वाला पहला भारतीय राज्य कौन सा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Karnataka launched the QR‑code based food‑safety complaint system, the first of its kind in India.
• Option A is Incorrect; Maharashtra has not yet rolled out such a QR‑code system.
• Option C is Incorrect; Tamil Nadu has not introduced this specific mechanism.
• Option D is Incorrect; Kerala has not implemented the QR‑code based complaint platform.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian railway coach factory developed the country's first Vande Bharat freight train that achieved a trial speed of 130 kmph?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा भारतीय रेलवे कोच फ़ैक्ट्री ने देश की पहली वंदे भारत फ्रेट ट्रेन को विकसित किया, जिसने 130 किमी/घंटा की परीक्षण गति हासिल की?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Vande Bharat freight train was designed and built by Integral Coach Factory (ICF), Chennai, and trial‑tested at 130 kmph on the Kota‑Rohal Khurd section.
• Option B is Incorrect because RCF manufactures conventional passenger coaches, not the Vande Bharat series.
• Option C is Incorrect because MCF produces modern passenger coaches but was not involved in this freight‑train project.
• Option D is Incorrect because Titagarh Wagons is a private manufacturer and did not develop this government‑led freight train.

national_questions.qe: Which public sector undertaking has invited Expressions of Interest for India's first geothermal power project in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands?
national_questions.qh: अंडमान और निकोबार द्वीपसमूह में भारत की पहली भू‑तापीय ऊर्जा परियोजना के लिए अभिव्यक्ति‑ऑफ़‑इंटरेस्ट (EoI) किस सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र की कंपनी ने आमंत्रित किया है?

oh: सोलर एनर्जी कॉरपोरेशन ऑफ इंडिया (SECI) लिमिटेड
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because SECI Ltd. issued the EoI to assess geothermal resources and develop a power plant in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
• Option A is Incorrect; NTPC focuses on thermal and hydro projects, not geothermal pilot studies.
• Option C is Incorrect; Power Grid is a transmission‑sector entity, not a project developer.
• Option D is Incorrect; IREDA provides financing for renewable projects but did not issue the EoI for this specific geothermal venture.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of the generative AI‑powered procurement platform launched by the Government e‑Marketplace in May 2025?
national_questions.qh: मई 2025 में सरकारी ई‑मार्केटप्लेस द्वारा लॉन्च किए गए जनरेटिव एआई‑संचालित खरीद प्लेटफ़ॉर्म का नाम क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Government e‑Marketplace (GeM) introduced ‘GeMAI’ – a generative‑AI‑enabled system for intelligent procurement.
• Option A is Incorrect; eProcureAI is a fictitious name not used by GeM.
• Option B is Incorrect; AI‑Market is not the official branding of the platform.
• Option D is Incorrect; SmartGeM refers to earlier digital enhancements, not the 2025 generative‑AI launch.

national_questions.qe: Which Soviet launch vehicle was used to place India's first experimental remote sensing satellites Bhaskara‑I and Bhaskara‑II into orbit?
national_questions.qh: भारत के पहले प्रयोगात्मक रिमोट‑सेंसिंग उपग्रह भास्कर‑I और भास्कर‑II को कक्षा में स्थापित करने के लिए कौन सा सोवियत लॉन्च वाहन उपयोग किया गया था?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because both Bhaskara‑I and Bhaskara‑II were launched aboard Soviet Intercosmos rockets.
• Option A is Incorrect; Vostok was used for early crewed missions, not these satellites.
• Option B is Incorrect; Soyuz served later payloads, not the 1979‑1981 Bhaskara launches.
• Option C is Incorrect; Proton was a heavy‑lift vehicle, whereas the Bhaskara missions employed the smaller Intercosmos launch system.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian city hosted the BRICS Youth Ministers' Meeting and BRICS Sports Ministers' Meeting in 2026 under India's BRICS Presidency?
national_questions.qh: भारत की BRICS अध्यक्षता के तहत 2026 में BRICS युवा मंत्रियों और BRICS खेल मंत्रियों की बैठक की मेजबानी किस भारतीय शहर ने की?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Visakhapatnam in Andhra Pradesh hosted the BRICS Youth Ministers' Meeting and Sports Ministers' Meeting, chaired by Union Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya.
• Option B is Incorrect because Kochi was not the host city for these ministerial meetings.
• Option C is Incorrect because Chennai hosted the 14th BRICS Science, Technology and Innovation Ministerial Meeting.
• Option D is Incorrect as Bengaluru did not host this BRICS event.

national_questions.qe: The 'Jaipur Declaration', centered around building resilience, innovation, and sustainability, was unanimously adopted during the meeting of BRICS Ministers of which sector?
national_questions.qh: 'जयपुर घोषणा-पत्र' (Jaipur Declaration), जो लचीलेपन, नवाचार और स्थिरता के निर्माण पर केंद्रित है, सर्वसम्मति से किस क्षेत्र के BRICS मंत्रियों की बैठक में अपनाया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because BRICS Tourism Ministers unanimously adopted the 'Jaipur Declaration' in Jaipur under India's BRICS Chairship to foster intra-BRICS tourism cooperation, AI technology in travel, and sustainable tourism practices.
• Option A is Incorrect because the declaration specifically relates to tourism cooperation.
• Option B is Incorrect because Environment Ministers were not the signatories of the Jaipur Declaration.
• Option D is Incorrect because Agriculture was not the domain of this ministerial meeting.

national_questions.qe: A triangular defense grid comprising Army posts in Chopra, Dhubri, and Kishanganj has been proposed to protect which strategically vital border corridor of India?
national_questions.qh: भारत के किस रणनीतिक रूप से संवेदनशील सीमावर्ती गलियारे की सुरक्षा के लिए चोपड़ा, धुबरी और किशनगंज में सेना की चौकियों का एक त्रिकोणीय रक्षा ग्रिड बनाने का प्रस्ताव दिया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because a triangular defense grid composed of Army posts in Chopra (West Bengal), Dhubri (Assam), and Kishanganj (Bihar) was proposed to safeguard the strategically crucial Siliguri Corridor ('Chicken's Neck').
• Option A is Incorrect because Sir Creek is located along the Gujarat border with Pakistan.
• Option B is Incorrect because Doklam is a tri-junction area between Bhutan, India, and China.
• Option C is Incorrect because Galwan Valley is situated in Eastern Ladakh.

national_questions.qe: Through which Constitutional Amendment Act was the Manipuri language included in the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution in 1992?
national_questions.qh: किस संवैधानिक संशोधन अधिनियम के तहत 1992 में मणिपुरी भाषा को भारतीय संविधान की आठवीं अनुसूची में शामिल किया गया था?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the 71st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 added Konkani, Manipuri, and Nepali languages to the Eighth Schedule on August 20, 1992.
• Option B is Incorrect because the 21st Amendment Act, 1967 added Sindhi as the 15th official language.
• Option C is Incorrect because the 92nd Amendment Act, 2003 added Bodo, Dogri, Maithili, and Santhali to the Eighth Schedule.
• Option D is Incorrect because the 86th Amendment Act, 2002 inserted Article 21A, making free and compulsory education a fundamental right.

national_questions.qe: At which major port was India's first Make-in-India 1-MW Green Hydrogen Plant established to boost the green maritime transition?
national_questions.qh: हरित समुद्री परिवर्तन को बढ़ावा देने के लिए किस प्रमुख बंदरगाह पर भारत का पहला 'मेक-इन-इंडिया' 1-मेगावाट ग्रीन हाइड्रोजन संयंत्र स्थापित किया गया था?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because India's first indigenous 1-MW Green Hydrogen Plant was built by the Deendayal Port Authority (DPA) at Kandla, Gujarat, to facilitate green maritime energy transition.
• Option A is Incorrect because Jawaharlal Nehru Port is a major container port located in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra.
• Option C is Incorrect because Visakhapatnam Port is a premier East Coast port in Andhra Pradesh.
• Option D is Incorrect because V.O. Chidambaranar Port is situated in Tamil Nadu.

national_questions.qe: On which section of the Udhampur-Srinagar-Baramulla Railway Link (USBRL) project is Anji Khad Bridge, India's first cable-stayed railway bridge, constructed?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला केबल-स्टेयड रेलवे पुल, अंजि खड्ड ब्रिज, उधमपुर-श्रीनगर-बारामूला रेलवे लिंक (USBRL) परियोजना के किस खंड पर निर्मित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Anji Khad Bridge is India's first cable-stayed railway bridge, spanning 1,200 meters on the Katra–Banihal section of the USBRL project across the Pir Panjal range.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Jammu–Udhampur section was commissioned in earlier phases of the project.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Banihal–Srinagar rail link was made operational prior to the complex Katra stretch.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Srinagar–Baramulla line forms the northern valley sector of the network.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian major port became the first to provide piped natural gas (PNG) connectivity to its residential township through the Urja Ganga pipeline network?
national_questions.qh: ऊर्जा गंगा पाइपलाइन नेटवर्क के माध्यम से अपने आवासीय टाउनशिप को पाइप प्राकृतिक गैस (PNG) कनेक्टिविटी प्रदान करने वाला भारत का पहला प्रमुख बंदरगाह कौन सा बना?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Paradip Port Authority in Odisha became India's first major port to connect 546 quarters in its residential township (Madhuban) with piped natural gas (PNG) utilizing the Urja Ganga pipeline and Dhamra LNG Terminal.
• Option A is Incorrect because Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port is located in West Bengal.
• Option B is Incorrect because Cochin Port is located in Kerala.
• Option C is Incorrect because Mormugao Port is located in Goa.

national_questions.qe: Where is India's first industrial-scale sugarcane-derived PLA biopolymer plant being established?
national_questions.qh: गन्ने से निर्मित भारत का पहला औद्योगिक पैमाने का PLA बायोपॉलिमर संयंत्र कहाँ स्थापित किया जा रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because India's first industrial-scale sugarcane-derived PLA biopolymer plant with an annual capacity of 80,000 tonnes is being established at Kumbhi in Lakhimpur Kheri, Uttar Pradesh by Balrampur Chini Mills Ltd.
• Option B is Incorrect because Patna, Bihar is not the site for this biopolymer facility.
• Option C is Incorrect because Pune, Maharashtra does not host this sugarcane-based biopolymer project.
• Option D is Incorrect because Ludhiana, Punjab is not associated with this facility.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian women's doubles pair secured India's historic bronze medal at the BWF World Championships 2026?
national_questions.qh: किस भारतीय महिला युगल जोड़ी ने BWF विश्व चैंपियनशिप 2026 में भारत का ऐतिहासिक कांस्य पदक हासिल किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand secured a historic bronze medal in the women's doubles event at the BWF World Championships held in New Delhi.
• Option A is Incorrect because Jwala Gutta and Ashwini Ponnappa won a medal in 2011, not in 2026.
• Option C is Incorrect because Saina Nehwal and PV Sindhu are singles players.
• Option D is Incorrect because Tanisha Crasto and Ashwini Ponnappa were not the medal-winning pair.

national_questions.qe: In which city was India’s first immersive language museum, named 'Shabdalok', inaugurated at Belvedere House?
national_questions.qh: बेलवेडेरे हाउस में 'शब्दलोक' नामक भारत के पहले इमर्सिव भाषा संग्रहालय का उद्घाटन किस शहर में किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because 'Shabdalok', India’s first immersive language museum, was established at Belvedere House inside the National Library premises in Kolkata, displaying the evolution of words across 22 constitutional languages.
• Option A is Incorrect because the museum is located in Kolkata, not New Delhi.
• Option B is Incorrect because Varanasi is not the location for Shabdalok.
• Option D is Incorrect because Mysuru is not the host city for this language museum.

national_questions.qe: India's first virtual zoo featuring a 14D immersive cinema and digital jungle safari was opened at which location?
national_questions.qh: 14D इमर्सिव सिनेमा और डिजिटल जंगल सफारी वाला भारत का पहला वर्चुअल चिड़ियाघर किस स्थान पर शुरू किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because India’s first virtual zoo was inaugurated at Kamala Nehru Prani Sangrahalaya in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, featuring a 14D theatre and a digital jungle safari developed under a PPP model.
• Option A is Incorrect because Vandalur Zoo in Tamil Nadu is a conventional physical zoo.
• Option B is Incorrect because Mysuru Zoo did not establish this virtual zoo facility.
• Option C is Incorrect because Sanjay Gandhi Jaivik Udyan in Patna is a standard biological park.

national_questions.qe: In which institute has India's first Sports Artificial Intelligence (AI) Centre been established?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला खेल कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (स्पोर्ट्स एआई) केंद्र किस संस्थान में स्थापित किया गया है?
oe: Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education (LNIPE), Gwalior
Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports (NIS), Patiala
Indira Gandhi Institute of Physical Education and Sports Sciences, New Delhi
Tamil Nadu Physical Education and Sports University, Chennai
oh: लक्ष्मीबाई राष्ट्रीय शारीरिक शिक्षा संस्थान (LNIPE), ग्वालियर
नेताजी सुभाष राष्ट्रीय खेल संस्थान (NIS), पटियाला
इंदिरा गांधी शारीरिक शिक्षा एवं खेल विज्ञान संस्थान, नई दिल्ली
तमिलनाडु शारीरिक शिक्षा और खेल विश्वविद्यालय, चेन्नई
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because India’s first Sports AI Centre was inaugurated at the Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education (LNIPE) in Gwalior to analyse athletes' physique and performance for early talent identification and training optimization.
• Option B is Incorrect because NIS Patiala is a major sports coaching institute but is not the site of this AI Centre.
• Option C is Incorrect because IGIPESS New Delhi is an institution under Delhi University and not the host of this facility.
• Option D is Incorrect because TNPESU Chennai is a state sports university in Tamil Nadu.

national_questions.qe: Which state government has announced the establishment of India's first government-owned Artificial Intelligence (AI) University in Bengaluru?
national_questions.qh: किस राज्य सरकार ने बेंगलुरु में भारत का पहला सरकारी स्वामित्व वाला कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (एआई) विश्वविद्यालय स्थापित करने की घोषणा की है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Karnataka government announced plans to set up India's first government-owned AI University in Bengaluru under its Udyoga Sankalpa and Udyoga Nidhi initiatives.
• Option A is Incorrect because Telangana has introduced AI applications in healthcare but not this university.
• Option C is Incorrect because Tamil Nadu is implementing tech policies independently of this initiative.
• Option D is Incorrect because Maharashtra has introduced AI skill surveys rather than an AI University in Bengaluru.

national_questions.qe: India's first university-led National Space Technology Conclave (NSTC) 2026 was organized by which institution in collaboration with ISRO and IIST?
national_questions.qh: इसरो (ISRO) और आईआईएसटी (IIST) के सहयोग से भारत का पहला विश्वविद्यालय-नेतृत्व वाला राष्ट्रीय अंतरिक्ष प्रौद्योगिकी सम्मेलन (NSTC) 2026 किस संस्थान द्वारा आयोजित किया गया?
oe: SRM Institute of Science and Technology
oh: एसआरएम इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ साइंस एंड टेक्नोलॉजी
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Chandigarh University's Kalpana Chawla Centre for Research in Space Science and Technology hosted India's first university-led National Space Technology Conclave (NSTC) 2026 in collaboration with ISRO and IIST.
• Option A is Incorrect because BITS Pilani was not the organizer of this event.
• Option B is Incorrect because SRM Institute is known for satellite projects but was not the host of NSTC 2026.
• Option D is Incorrect because Amity University did not convene this conclave.

national_questions.qe: Prakriti Gyan Dham, designated as India's first interactive eco-educational hub, has been developed by which CSIR laboratory in Banthra, Lucknow?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला इंटरएक्टिव इको-एजुकेशनल हब घोषित 'प्रकृति ज्ञान धाम', बंथरा (लखनऊ) में किस सीएसआईआर (CSIR) प्रयोगशाला द्वारा विकसित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because 'Prakriti Gyan Dham' was developed by the CSIR-National Botanical Research Institute (CSIR-NBRI) at the Maharishi Parashar Bioresource Centre in Banthra, Lucknow.
• Option A is Incorrect because CSIR-CLRI is located in Chennai and deals with leather technology.
• Option B is Incorrect because CSIR-CDRI focuses on pharmaceutical drug development.
• Option C is Incorrect because CSIR-IITR specializes in toxicology research.

national_questions.qe: On which day is National Space Day celebrated in India to commemorate the soft landing of Chandrayaan-3 on the lunar south pole?
national_questions.qh: चंद्रयान-3 के चंद्रमा के दक्षिणी ध्रुव पर सफलतापूर्वक सॉफ्ट लैंडिंग के उपलक्ष्य में भारत में किस दिन 'राष्ट्रीय अंतरिक्ष दिवस' मनाया जाता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because National Space Day is officially celebrated across India on August 23 to mark the historic achievement of Chandrayaan-3 landing on the Moon's south polar region in 2023.
• Option A is Incorrect because August 15 is India's Independence Day.
• Option C is Incorrect because October 2 is Gandhi Jayanti.
• Option D is Incorrect because November 26 is observed as Constitution Day (Samvidhan Divas).

national_questions.qe: Who among the following was appointed as the interlocutor to head the high-level committee constituted by the Union Home Ministry for addressing Gorkha community issues?
national_questions.qh: निम्नलिखित में से किसे गोरखा समुदाय के मुद्दों के समाधान के लिए केंद्रीय गृह मंत्रालय द्वारा गठित उच्च स्तरीय समिति का अध्यक्ष (वार्ताकार) नियुक्त किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Union Ministry of Home Affairs constituted a high-level committee headed by Interlocutor Pankaj Singh (former BSF Director General and Deputy NSA) to resolve regional issues concerning the Gorkha community in Darjeeling, Terai, and Dooars.
• Option A is Incorrect because General Anil Chauhan is the Chief of Defence Staff (CDS).
• Option B is Incorrect because Tapan Deka serves as the Director of the Intelligence Bureau.
• Option D is Incorrect because Samant Goel is a former chief of R&AW.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian city hosted the 14th BRICS Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) Ministerial Meeting?
national_questions.qh: किस भारतीय शहर ने 14वीं ब्रिक्स विज्ञान, प्रौद्योगिकी और नवाचार (STI) मंत्रिस्तरीय बैठक की मेजबानी की?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the 14th BRICS Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) Ministerial Meeting was held in Chennai under India's BRICS presidency.
• Option A is Incorrect because Bengaluru was not the venue for this STI ministerial conference.
• Option B is Incorrect because New Delhi hosts central diplomatic events, but Chennai was selected specifically for this 14th STI meeting.
• Option C is Incorrect because Hyderabad did not host this BRICS event.

national_questions.qe: Who heads the five-member High-Powered Enquiry Committee constituted by the Supreme Court to examine allegations of violence during student demonstrations?
national_questions.qh: छात्र प्रदर्शनों के दौरान हिंसा के आरोपों की जांच के लिए उच्चतम न्यायालय द्वारा गठित पांच सदस्यीय उच्च स्तरीय जांच समिति का अध्यक्ष किसे नियुक्त किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Supreme Court constituted a five-member High-Powered Enquiry Committee headed by former Supreme Court judge Justice R Subhash Reddy to independently probe student protest violence.
• Option A is Incorrect because Justice U.U. Lalit is a former Chief Justice of India and is not part of this committee.
• Option B is Incorrect because Justice N.V. Ramana is a former CJI and was not appointed to head this inquiry.
• Option C is Incorrect because Justice A.M. Khanwilkar is not the designated head of this panel.

national_questions.qe: At which place is the Indo-Russian Rifles Private Limited (IRRPL) facility located, where India's first 100% indigenised AK-203 ('Sher') assault rifle was manufactured and test-fired?
national_questions.qh: इंडो-रशियन राइफल्स प्राइवेट लिमिटेड (IRRPL) की वह सुविधा कहाँ स्थित है, जहाँ भारत की पहली 100% स्वदेशी AK-203 ('शेर') असॉल्ट राइफल का निर्माण और सफल परीक्षण किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because India’s first 100% indigenised AK-203 'Sher' assault rifle was manufactured and test-fired at the Indo-Russian Rifles Private Limited (IRRPL) factory in Amethi, Uttar Pradesh.
• Option B is Incorrect because Jabalpur is home to traditional Ordnance Factories, not the IRRPL AK-203 unit.
• Option C is Incorrect because Koraput is known for HAL aero-engine manufacturing.
• Option D is Incorrect because Avadi is famous for Heavy Vehicles Factory producing tanks, not the AK-203 rifles.

national_questions.qe: In which state was India's first non-GMO high-expansion popcorn maize hybrid seed launched by Vice President CP Radhakrishnan?
national_questions.qh: उपराष्ट्रपति सीपी राधाकृष्णन द्वारा भारत का पहला गैर-जीएमओ (non-GMO) हाई-एक्सपेंशन पॉपकॉर्न मक्का हाइब्रिड बीज किस राज्य में लॉन्च किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Vice President CP Radhakrishnan launched India's first non-GMO high-expansion popcorn maize hybrid seed in Musunuru village, Eluru district, Andhra Pradesh.
• Option A is Incorrect because the seed launch took place in Andhra Pradesh, not Telangana.
• Option C is Incorrect because Karnataka is not the site of this premier hybrid seed launch.
• Option D is Incorrect because Punjab was not the location for this agricultural milestone.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of India's first state-led Earth Observation satellite system being implemented under the DBLOTT model?
national_questions.qh: DBLOTT मॉडल के तहत लागू की जा रही भारत की पहली राज्य-नेतृत्व वाली अर्थ ऑब्जर्वेशन उपग्रह प्रणाली (Earth Observation Satellite System) का नाम क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because AssamSAT is India’s first state-led Earth Observation satellite system, being implemented under the DBLOTT (Design, Build, Launch, Operate, Train and Transfer) model by the Assam government.
• Option A is Incorrect because PragatiSAT is not the official name of this project.
• Option B is Incorrect because BrahmaputraSAT is a fictitious name not associated with this project.
• Option D is Incorrect because NortheastSAT is not the designated name of Assam's satellite system.

national_questions.qe: In which state is India's first government hospital featuring an AI-based pneumatic tube system for rapid sample transport located?
national_questions.qh: त्वरित नमूना परिवहन के लिए एआई-आधारित न्यूमैटिक ट्यूब सिस्टम स्थापित करने वाला भारत का पहला सरकारी अस्पताल किस राज्य में स्थित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Dr Marri Chenna Reddy TIMS in Telangana became India’s first government hospital to install an AI-based pneumatic tube system that transports blood samples and medical reports between wards, labs, and pharmacy within 1–2 minutes.
• Option B is Incorrect because Karnataka is not the state hosting this specific facility.
• Option C is Incorrect because Tamil Nadu is not associated with this milestone.
• Option D is Incorrect because Maharashtra has not launched this specific hospital pneumatic system.

national_questions.qe: India's first virtual zoo featuring a 14-D cinema and digital jungle safari has been established in which city?
national_questions.qh: 14-D सिनेमा और डिजिटल जंगल सफारी की सुविधा वाला भारत का पहला वर्चुअल चिड़ियाघर किस शहर में स्थापित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because India's first virtual zoo was inaugurated at Kamala Nehru Prani Sangrahalaya in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, featuring a 14-D cinema, 3-D dome theatre, and digital jungle safari under a PPP model.
• Option A is Incorrect because Bhopal is not the host city for this virtual zoo initiative.
• Option C is Incorrect because Jaipur does not host this facility.
• Option D is Incorrect because Lucknow is not related to this milestone.

national_questions.qe: In which city will India’s first government-owned Artificial Intelligence (AI) University be established?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला सरकारी स्वामित्व वाला कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (AI) विश्वविद्यालय किस शहर में स्थापित किया जाएगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Karnataka state government announced the establishment of India's first government-owned AI University in Bengaluru.
• Option A is Incorrect because Hyderabad is not the designated site for this state-owned AI university.
• Option B is Incorrect because Pune is not the chosen city.
• Option D is Incorrect because Gandhinagar is not the location for Karnataka's state AI university initiative.

national_questions.qe: Which state recently launched India's first AI-powered household-level skill census model to assess urban employment potential?
national_questions.qh: हाल ही में किस राज्य ने शहरी रोजगार क्षमता का आकलन करने के लिए भारत का पहला एआई-संचालित घरेलू-स्तरीय कौशल जनगणना मॉडल शुरू किया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because India's first AI-powered household-level skill census model was launched in the H/West ward of Mumbai Suburban district in Maharashtra to create a blueprint for urban employment and livelihood intelligence.
• Option A is Incorrect because Gujarat did not pilot this household-level AI skill census model.
• Option B is Incorrect because Delhi is not the state carrying out this pilot project.
• Option C is Incorrect because Karnataka is not associated with this skill census model.

national_questions.qe: Which state police force recently launched the 'My Police Station' initiative featuring dedicated help desks for senior citizens, transgender persons, and persons with disabilities?
national_questions.qh: किस राज्य के पुलिस बल ने हाल ही में वरिष्ठ नागरिकों, ट्रांसजेंडर व्यक्तियों और दिव्यांगजनों के लिए समर्पित हेल्प डेस्क वाली 'माई पुलिस स्टेशन' पहल शुरू की है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Kerala Police launched the 'My Police Station' initiative, establishing specialized help desks for women, children, senior citizens, transgender individuals, persons with disabilities, cybercrime assistance, and legal aid.
• Option A is Incorrect because Tamil Nadu Police has separate public outreach programs.
• Option C is Incorrect because Karnataka Police is not associated with the 'My Police Station' drive.
• Option D is Incorrect because Maharashtra Police is not the implementing authority for this project.

national_questions.qe: In which year was the Special Representatives (SR) talks mechanism between India and China established to address bilateral boundary disputes?
national_questions.qh: सीमा विवादों को हल करने के लिए भारत और चीन के बीच विशेष प्रतिनिधियों (SR) का वार्ता तंत्र किस वर्ष स्थापित किया गया था?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: The Special Representatives (SR) mechanism for India-China boundary negotiations was established in 2003. National Security Advisor Ajit Doval participated in the 25th round of SR talks in Beijing with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi under this framework.
• Option B is Incorrect: 1998 predates the creation of the formal SR negotiations framework.
• Option C is Incorrect: 2010 is incorrect as the mechanism was established earlier.
• Option D is Incorrect: 2015 is incorrect.

national_questions.qe: By which target year have India and Russia agreed to achieve a bilateral trade volume of $100 billion?
national_questions.qh: भारत और रूस किस लक्ष्य वर्ष तक $100 अरब डॉलर के द्विपक्षीय व्यापार आंकड़े को प्राप्त करने पर सहमत हुए हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct: During bilateral talks in Moscow co-chaired by External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar and Russian First Deputy PM Denis Manturov, both nations reaffirmed their goal to reach $100 billion in annual trade by 2030.
• Option A is Incorrect: 2026 is not the set target timeline.
• Option B is Incorrect: 2028 is incorrect.
• Option C is Incorrect: 2035 is beyond the agreed timeline of 2030.

national_questions.qe: What is the primary objective of the ₹5,000 crore 'PRIP' scheme launched by the Government of India?
national_questions.qh: भारत सरकार द्वारा शुरू की गई ₹5,000 करोड़ की 'PRIP' योजना का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
oe: To subsidize life-saving imported foreign pharmaceuticals
To promote research and innovation in the pharma-medtech sector
To establish free generic drug dispensaries in all rural districts
To digitize healthcare databases across all private hospitals
oh: जीवनरक्षक आयातित विदेशी दवाओं पर सब्सिडी प्रदान करना
फार्मा-मेडटेक क्षेत्र में अनुसंधान और नवाचार को बढ़ावा देना
सभी ग्रामीण जिलों में मुफ्त जेनेरिक दवा केंद्र स्थापित करना
सभी निजी अस्पतालों के स्वास्थ्य सेवा डेटाबेस का डिजिटलीकरण करना
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Promotion of Research and Innovation in Pharma-MedTech Sector (PRIP) scheme, with an outlay of ₹5,000 crore, aims to transform India from a volume-based pharmaceutical manufacturing hub into an innovation-led research hub through industry-academia collaboration.
• Option A is Incorrect because the scheme focuses on domestic innovation and R&D rather than subsidizing foreign imported drugs.
• Option C is Incorrect because generic drug distribution in rural areas is supported under schemes like Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP).
• Option D is Incorrect because health record digitization is managed under the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM).

national_questions.qe: The prestigious 'Jayadev Puraskar' is the highest lifetime achievement award presented in the field of cinema by which Indian state?
national_questions.qh: प्रतिष्ठित 'जयदेव पुरस्कार' किस भारतीय राज्य द्वारा सिनेमा के क्षेत्र में दिया जाने वाला सर्वोच्च लाइफटाइम अचीवमेंट पुरस्कार है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Jayadev Puraskar is the highest state award given by the Government of Odisha for lifetime contribution to Odia cinema. Legendary singer Pranab Patnaik, who passed away recently, was a recipient of this prestigious honor.
• Option A is Incorrect because West Bengal's highest state cinematic award is the Tele Cine Award or awards under the West Bengal Film Journalists' Association.
• Option B is Incorrect because Assam presents state film awards such as the Prag Cine Awards and State Film Awards.
• Option C is Incorrect because Jharkhand does not confer the Jayadev Puraskar.

national_questions.qe: What is the official name designated for the landing site of ISRO's Chandrayaan-3 lander module on the Moon's south polar region?
national_questions.qh: चंद्रमा के दक्षिणी ध्रुवीय क्षेत्र पर इसरो के चंद्रयान-3 लैंडर मॉड्यूल के लैंडिंग स्थल का आधिकारिक नाम क्या रखा गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the touch-down site of Chandrayaan-3's Vikram lander near the lunar south pole on August 23, 2023, was officially named 'Shiv Shakti Point', and August 23 was declared 'National Space Day'.
• Option B is Incorrect because 'Tiranga Point' is the name designated for the site where Chandrayaan-2's lander crash-landed on the Moon.
• Option C is Incorrect because 'Jawahar Point' is the impact site of the Moon Impact Probe (MIP) launched by Chandrayaan-1 in 2008.
• Option D is Incorrect because 'Vikram Point' is not an officially designated site name by ISRO.

national_questions.qe: What is the target year set by the Government of India for establishing the country's independent space station, the Bharatiya Antariksha Station (BAS)?
national_questions.qh: भारत सरकार द्वारा देश के स्वतंत्र अंतरिक्ष स्टेशन, 'भारतीय अंतरिक्ष स्टेशन' (BAS) को स्थापित करने का लक्ष्य वर्ष क्या निर्धारित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because India plans to set up the Bharatiya Antariksha Station (BAS) by 2035 as part of ISRO's long-term space roadmap, with the first module (BAS-01) planned for deployment by 2028.
• Option A is Incorrect because 2028 is the target year for launching the first baseline module (BAS-01), not the fully operational space station.
• Option B is Incorrect because 2030 is not the designated milestone year for BAS completion.
• Option D is Incorrect because 2040 is the target year set for sending an Indian astronaut to the Moon under the crewed lunar mission roadmap.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian space-tech startup launched India's first private rocket to deploy satellites into orbit?
national_questions.qh: उपग्रहों को कक्षा में स्थापित करने के लिए भारत का पहला निजी रॉकेट किस भारतीय स्पेस-टेक स्टार्टअप द्वारा लॉन्च किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Skyroot Aerospace, India's first space-tech unicorn, achieved the milestone of launching India's first private rocket to deploy satellites into orbit.
• Option A is Incorrect because Agnikul Cosmos developed the Agnibaan SOrTeD launch vehicle.
• Option C is Incorrect because Bellatrix Aerospace specializes in satellite propulsion and orbital transfer vehicles.
• Option D is Incorrect because Pixxel is a space-data company focused on hyperspectral Earth observation satellites.

national_questions.qe: India's first Virtual Zoo, featuring a 14-D cinema and digital jungle safari experience, has been established in which city?
national_questions.qh: 14-D सिनेमा और डिजिटल जंगल सफारी अनुभव वाला भारत का पहला वर्चुअल ज़ू (आभासी चिड़ियाघर) किस शहर में स्थापित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because India's first virtual zoo was established at the Kamala Nehru Prani Sangrahalaya in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, under a PPP model.
• Option A is Incorrect because Sri Chamarajendra Zoological Gardens is located in Mysuru.
• Option B is Incorrect because Indira Gandhi Zoological Park is located in Visakhapatnam.
• Option D is Incorrect because Nandankanan Zoological Park is located in Bhubaneswar.

national_questions.qe: Which medical institution became the first government hospital in India to deploy an AI-based pneumatic tube system for automated sample transport?
national_questions.qh: स्वचालित नमूना परिवहन के लिए AI-आधारित न्यूमैटिक ट्यूब सिस्टम स्थापित करने वाला भारत का पहला सरकारी अस्पताल कौन सा बना?
oe: Dr Marri Chenna Reddy TIMS, Telangana
oh: डॉ मरि चेन्ना रेड्डी टिम्स (TIMS), तेलंगाना
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Dr Marri Chenna Reddy Telangana Institute of Medical Sciences (TIMS) became the first government hospital in India to install an AI-based pneumatic tube system to transport blood samples and medical reports within 1–2 minutes.
• Option B is Incorrect because AIIMS New Delhi is a premier institute but did not pioneer this AI pneumatic system.
• Option C is Incorrect because PGIMER Chandigarh is a major tertiary care hospital in Chandigarh.
• Option D is Incorrect because IPGMER is located in Kolkata, West Bengal.

national_questions.qe: Which autonomous agency under the Department of Space acts as the single-window body to authorize and promote private space entities and startups in India?
national_questions.qh: अंतरिक्ष विभाग के तहत कौन सी स्वायत्त एजेंसी भारत में गैर-सरकारी निजी संस्थाओं और स्टार्टअप्स को अधिकृत और प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए एकल-खिड़की निकाय के रूप में कार्य करती है?
oe: ISRO Telemetry Tracking and Command Network (ISTRAC)
Indian National Space Promotion and Authorization Centre (IN-SPACe)
oh: इसरो टेलीमेट्री ट्रैकिंग एंड कमांड नेटवर्क (ISTRAC)
भारतीय राष्ट्रीय अंतरिक्ष संवर्धन और प्राधिकरण केंद्र (IN-SPACe)
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because IN-SPACe is the single-window nodal agency under the Department of Space tasked with regulating, authorizing, and promoting non-government private space entities in India.
• Option A is Incorrect because Antrix Corporation Limited is the primary commercial arm handling legacy satellite commercialization.
• Option B is Incorrect because NewSpace India Limited (NSIL) is a CPSE under DOS tasked with commercializing space assets and manufacturing launch vehicles.
• Option C is Incorrect because ISTRAC provides tracking, telemetry, and command support to space missions.

national_questions.qe: Which organization indigenously developed the upgraded Dak MITRA and Dak Sewa mobile applications launched under the Department of Posts IT 2.0 Modernization?
national_questions.qh: डाक विभाग के 'IT 2.0 आधुनिकीकरण' के तहत लॉन्च किए गए उन्नत 'डाक मित्र' (Dak MITRA) और 'डाक सेवा' (Dak Sewa) मोबाइल ऐप को किस संगठन द्वारा स्वदेशी रूप से विकसित किया गया है?
oe: Centre for Excellence in Postal Technology (CEPT)
Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the upgraded Dak MITRA and Dak Sewa mobile applications were developed indigenously by the Centre for Excellence in Postal Technology (CEPT) under the Advanced Postal Technology (APT) platform as part of DoP IT 2.0 Modernization.
• Option B is Incorrect because NIC develops general government web portals and e-governance systems.
• Option C is Incorrect because C-DAC specializes in supercomputing and advanced software solutions.
• Option D is Incorrect because ITI Limited is a telecom equipment manufacturing public sector undertaking.

national_questions.qe: Which premier autonomous institute launched 'Garbhini Mitra', a specialized six-month offline healthcare skill-development course for maternal care?
national_questions.qh: किस प्रमुख स्वायत्त संस्थान ने मातृ देखभाल के लिए छह महीने के विशेष ऑफ़लाइन स्वास्थ्य कौशल-विकास पाठ्यक्रम 'गर्भिणी मित्र' (Garbhini Mitra) का शुभारंभ किया है?
oe: National Institute of Health and Family Welfare (NIHFW)
Post Graduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER)
oh: राष्ट्रीय स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण संस्थान (NIHFW)
स्नातकोत्तर चिकित्सा शिक्षा एवं अनुसंधान संस्थान (PGIMER)
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA), New Delhi, launched the 'Garbhini Mitra' course to integrate classical Ayurvedic maternal care (Garbhadhana Vidhi, Garbhini Paricharya) with modern non-clinical protocols like Basic Life Support.
• Option A is Incorrect because NIHFW focuses on health policy training and managerial education rather than Ayurvedic maternal skill courses.
• Option C is Incorrect because PGIMER is a medical institute in Chandigarh not associated with this program.
• Option D is Incorrect because ICMR is India's apex medical research body, not the course conducting institute.

national_questions.qe: What duration of approval exemption is granted to Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) under the Puducherry Business Reforms Bill, 2026?
national_questions.qh: पुडुचेरी व्यवसाय सुधार विधेयक, 2026 (Puducherry Business Reforms Bill, 2026) के तहत सूक्ष्म, लघु और मध्यम उद्यमों (MSMEs) को कितने वर्षों के लिए स्वीकृति छूट (approval exemption) प्रदान की गई है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Puducherry Business Reforms Bill, 2026 extends approval exemptions for MSMEs up to 5 years, with a provision for a 1-year extension to transition business regulation from permission-based to rule-based governance.
• Option A is Incorrect because 3 years is standard in older state regulatory frameworks.
• Option B is Incorrect because 4 years is not the duration enacted in this legislation.
• Option D is Incorrect because 7 years exceeds the statutory framework specified in the Bill.

national_questions.qe: Which component contributed the highest share (US $65.40 billion) to the total US $73 billion forex inflows mobilized under the RBI's special USD-INR swap facility in 2026?
national_questions.qh: वर्ष 2026 में भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक (RBI) की विशेष USD-INR स्वैप सुविधा के तहत जुटाए गए कुल 73 अरब डॉलर में से सर्वाधिक योगदान (65.40 अरब डॉलर) किस श्रेणी का रहा?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Foreign Currency Non-Resident (Bank) [FCNR(B)] deposits accounted for US $65.40 billion out of the total US $73 billion mobilized under the RBI's special USD-INR forex swap facility.
• Option A is Incorrect because FPI refers to institutional investments in Indian equity and debt securities.
• Option B is Incorrect because ECB consists of commercial loans raised by Indian corporations from overseas markets.
• Option C is Incorrect because FDI involves direct equity investment in Indian business entities.

national_questions.qe: By which year has the Government of India targeted to expand the domestic chemical sector economy to $1 trillion?
national_questions.qh: भारत सरकार ने घरेलू रसायन क्षेत्र की अर्थव्यवस्था को 1 ट्रिलियन डॉलर तक बढ़ाने का लक्ष्य किस वर्ष तक निर्धारित किया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Union Minister J.P. Nadda announced a strategic target to expand India's chemical sector to $1 trillion by 2040 during a CEO Roundtable in New Delhi.
• Option A is Incorrect because 2030 is the timeline for intermediate green targets, not the $1 trillion chemical sector milestone.
• Option B is Incorrect because 2035 is not the target year set by the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilisers.
• Option D is Incorrect because 2050 represents long-term net-zero goals rather than the chemical sector expansion roadmap.

national_questions.qe: In which city was the 9th National Security Strategies Conference inaugurated by Union Home Minister Amit Shah?
national_questions.qh: केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री अमित शाह द्वारा 9वें राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा रणनीतियों के सम्मेलन का उद्घाटन किस शहर में किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the 9th National Security Strategies Conference in New Delhi, emphasizing AI-based threat analysis on Multi-Agency Centre platforms.
• Option B is Incorrect because Gandhinagar was not the host venue for this national conference.
• Option C is Incorrect because Hyderabad did not host the 9th edition of this security conference.
• Option D is Incorrect because Bengaluru was not the designated location for this annual event.

national_questions.qe: Which country hosted the 17th Conference of Parties (COP17) to the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD)?
national_questions.qh: मरुस्थलीकरण से निपटने के लिए संयुक्त राष्ट्र अभिसमय (UNCCD) के पक्षकारों के 17वें सम्मेलन (COP17) की मेजबानी किस देश ने की?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the 17th Conference of Parties (COP17) to UNCCD was held in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, where India highlighted its Green Credit Programme.
• Option A is Incorrect because Uzbekistan hosted the CRIC21 meeting of UNCCD, not COP17.
• Option C is Incorrect because Saudi Arabia hosted UNCCD COP16 in Riyadh.
• Option D is Incorrect because Kenya was not the host nation for COP17.

national_questions.qe: Which Defence Public Sector Undertaking (DPSU) is manufacturing a commercial cargo ship for Germany under the 'Make in India' initiative?
national_questions.qh: 'मेक इन इंडिया' पहल के तहत कौन सा रक्षा सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र उपक्रम (DPSU) जर्मनी के लिए एक व्यावसायिक मालवाहक जहाज का निर्माण कर रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers (GRSE), a Kolkata-based Navratna DPSU, is currently constructing a commercial cargo vessel for Germany.
• Option A is Incorrect because Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited is based in Mumbai and primarily builds warships and submarines.
• Option B is Incorrect because Goa Shipyard Limited is not constructing this export vessel for Germany.
• Option C is Incorrect because Cochin Shipyard Limited is located in Kerala and is not the builder for this specific project.

national_questions.qe: What reservation percentage is granted to ex‑servicemen under Uttarakhand's Agniveer Employment Cell?
national_questions.qh: उत्तarakhand के अग्निवीर रोजगार सेल के तहत पूर्व सैनिकों को कौन‑सा आरक्षण प्रतिशत दिया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Uttarakhand Agniveer Employment Cell provides a 10% reservation, age relaxation and priority recruitment for ex‑servicemen.
• Option A is Incorrect because the scheme does not limit reservation to 5%.
• Option B is Incorrect as the policy explicitly includes a reservation benefit.
• Option D is Incorrect because the reservation is 10%, not 15%.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry is the nodal authority for the production of India's first fully indigenised AK‑203 “Sher” assault rifle at IRRPL Korwa, Amethi?
national_questions.qh: भारत के पहले पूर्णतः स्वदेशी AK‑203 “Sher” असॉल्ट राइफल के उत्पादन के लिए इर्रप्ल कोरवा, अमेठी में कौन‑सी मंत्रालय मुख्य प्राधिकरण है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the AK‑203 “Sher” is a defence‑manufacturing project under the Ministry of Defence.
• Option B is Incorrect as the Home Ministry does not oversee weapons production.
• Option C is Incorrect because foreign affairs are unrelated to indigenous rifle manufacturing.
• Option D is Incorrect; the Science and Technology Ministry is not the nodal agency for this defence project.

national_questions.qe: What is the designated name of the first module of India's space station approved by the Union Cabinet?
national_questions.qh: केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल द्वारा स्वीकृत भारत के अंतरिक्ष स्टेशन के पहले मॉड्यूल का नाम क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Union Cabinet approved the first module named BAS‑01 (Bharatiya Antariksha Station‑01).
• Option A is Incorrect; ISS‑1 refers to the International Space Station.
• Option C is Incorrect; Gaganyaan‑1 is the crewed spacecraft, not the space‑station module.
• Option D is Incorrect; Chandrayaan‑3 is a lunar mission, unrelated to the space‑station.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry is the nodal authority for the launch of National Common Mobility Card (NCMC) usage by state transport concession passengers in Maharashtra?

Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

national_questions.qe: Which company achieved India's first production of liquid‑cooled AC and DC power modules for electric‑vehicle chargers?
national_questions.qh: इलेक्ट्रिक‑वाहन चार्जरों के लिए भारत की पहली लिक्विड‑कूल्ड एसी और डीसी पावर मॉड्यूल का उत्पादन किस कंपनी ने किया?

• Option C is Incorrect as Mahindra Electric focuses on vehicle manufacturing, not power module fabrication.

national_questions.qe: What is the full form of 'PRAGATI', the multi-modal governance platform chaired monthly by the Prime Minister of India to review major infrastructure projects?
national_questions.qh: प्रमुख अवसंरचना परियोजनाओं की समीक्षा के लिए भारत के प्रधानमंत्री द्वारा मासिक रूप से अध्यक्षता किए जाने वाले बहु-स्तरीय शासन मंच 'PRAGATI' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
oe: Program for Rapid Advancement of Governance and Technical Infrastructure
Public Reform and Action Group for Transparent Implementation
Platform for Regional Advancement, Governance and Targeted Infrastructure
oh: प्रो-एक्टिव गवर्नेंस एंड टाइमली इम्प्लीमेंटेशन (Pro-Active Governance And Timely Implementation)
प्रोग्राम फॉर रैपिड एडवांसमेंट ऑफ गवर्नेंस एंड टेक्निकल इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर
पब्लिक रिफॉर्म एंड एक्शन ग्रुप फॉर ट्रांसपेरेंट इम्प्लीमेंटेशन

national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because PRAGATI stands for 'Pro-Active Governance And Timely Implementation', a unique integrating and interactive platform aimed at addressing common man's grievances and monitoring key programs and projects.
• Option B is Incorrect because it is a fabricated expansion.
• Option C is Incorrect because it does not represent the official acronym.
• Option D is Incorrect because it is an incorrect expansion of PRAGATI.

national_questions.qe: What was the record consolidated net profit recorded by India's Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) in the Financial Year FY26?
national_questions.qh: वित्तीय वर्ष FY26 में भारत के क्षेत्रीय ग्रामीण बैंकों (RRBs) द्वारा दर्ज किया गया रिकॉर्ड समेकित शुद्ध लाभ (consolidated net profit) कितना था?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) achieved a historic consolidated net profit of Rs 10,176 crore in FY26, marking a 49% growth over the previous fiscal year.
• Option A is Incorrect because Rs 6,820 crore was the net profit recorded in the previous fiscal year.
• Option B is Incorrect because it is an inaccurate figure.
• Option C is Incorrect because it does not reflect the total net profit recorded in FY26.

national_questions.qe: What is the main strategic principle of the 'Narcotics Control Vision Document 2026-2029' unveiled at the National Security Strategies Conference?
national_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा रणनीति सम्मेलन में अनावरण किए गए 'नारकोटिक्स कंट्रोल विजन डॉक्यूमेंट 2026-2029' का मुख्य रणनीतिक सिद्धांत क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the 'Narcotics Control Vision Document 2026-2029' is built around the three-pillar strategy of 'Detect, Disrupt, Destroy' to tackle illicit drug networks nationwide.
• Option A is Incorrect because 'Track, Intercept, Prosecute' is not the designated motto of the Vision Document.
• Option B is Incorrect as it refers to generic counter-terrorism isolation frameworks.
• Option D is Incorrect because it does not represent the official policy pillars laid out by the Union Home Ministry.

national_questions.qe: According to the Supreme Court's guidelines based on the landmark September 1993 Office Memorandum, which factor alone cannot determine exclusion under the OBC creamy layer criteria?
national_questions.qh: सितंबर 1993 के ऐतिहासिक कार्यालय ज्ञापन पर आधारित सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के दिशा-निर्देशों के अनुसार, किस कारक को अकेले OBC क्रीमी लेयर से बाहर करने का आधार नहीं बनाया जा सकता है?
oe: Parental salary or income alone without applying post status and wealth tests
Direct employment in public sector undertakings
Ownership of agricultural land exceeding statutory ceiling limits
oh: पद के स्तर और संपत्ति परीक्षणों को लागू किए बिना केवल माता-पिता का वेतन या आय
सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के उपक्रमों में प्रत्यक्ष रोजगार
वैधानिक सीमा से अधिक कृषि भूमि का स्वामित्व
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Supreme Court reiterated that parental salary or income alone in public or private sector employment cannot determine creamy-layer exclusion without applying the post-status and wealth tests mandated under the September 8, 1993 OM.
• Option B is Incorrect because employment status combined with post equivalence is part of the evaluation.
• Option C is Incorrect because holding constitutional posts automatically qualifies individuals for the creamy layer.
• Option D is Incorrect as landholding above specified ceiling limits is a valid criterion under the wealth test.

national_questions.qe: Which specialized body developed the Unified Payments Interface (UPI), India's flagship real-time digital payment system launched in 2016?
national_questions.qh: 2016 में शुरू की गई भारत की प्रमुख वास्तविक समय डिजिटल भुगतान प्रणाली 'यूनिफाइड पेमेंट्स इंटरफेस' (UPI) का विकास किस विशिष्ट निकाय द्वारा किया गया था?
oe: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Unified Payments Interface (UPI) was developed by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) in 2016 as an umbrella organization for operating retail payments and settlement systems in India.
• Option A is Incorrect because RBI acts as the regulatory authority, not the developer of UPI.
• Option B is Incorrect because NITI Aayog is a policy think tank.
• Option C is Incorrect because MeitY provides overall digital infrastructure support but did not build the core UPI architectural framework.

national_questions.qe: In which city was the World Athletics Continental Tour (Silver Level) hosted in India, where javelin thrower Rohit Yadav clinched the gold medal?
national_questions.qh: विश्व एथलेटिक्स कॉन्टिनेंटल टूर (सिल्वर लेवल) का आयोजन भारत के किस शहर में किया गया था, जहाँ भाला फेंक खिलाड़ी रोहित यादव ने स्वर्ण पदक जीता?

national_questions.qe: Which organization recently approved the establishment of the National Coach Accreditation Board to standardize sports coach development in India?
national_questions.qh: हाल ही में भारत में खेल कोचों के मानकीकृत विकास के लिए 'राष्ट्रीय कोच प्रत्यायन बोर्ड' स्थापित करने की मंजूरी किस संस्था ने दी है?
oe: Board of Control for Cricket in India
national_questions.e:

national_questions.qe: Where is India's first Underground Coal Gasification (UCG) pilot project being implemented by Eastern Coalfields Limited?
national_questions.qh: इस्टर्न कोलफील्ड्स लिमिटेड (ECL) द्वारा भारत की पहली अंडरग्राउंड कोल गैसीफिकेशन (UCG) पायलट परियोजना कहाँ कार्यान्वित की जा रही है?
national_questions.e:

• Option A is Incorrect because Singrauli is managed by NCL and is not the location for this UCG pilot project.
• Option B is Incorrect because Talcher is prominent for surface coal gasification fertilizer plants.

national_questions.qe: Which Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) is responsible for implementing India's first High-Speed Rail Corridor between Mumbai and Ahmedabad?
national_questions.qh: मुंबई और अहमदाबाद के बीच भारत के पहले हाई-स्पीड रेल कॉरिडोर का निर्माण और कार्यान्वयन किस एजेंसी द्वारा किया जा रहा है?

डेग्रिकेटेड फ्रेट कॉरिडोर कॉर्पोरेशन ऑफ इंडिया

national_questions.qe: Which state has launched India's first official state-level hockey league, inaugurated at the Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Hockey Stadium?

national_questions.qe: In which city has India's first solar-powered 'Algae Tree' been installed to promote bio-energy generation and air purification?

• Option D is Incorrect because Jaipur is not the site for this urban eco-innovation project.

bihar_questions.qe: What was the total number of digital X‑ray machines deployed in Bihar's tuberculosis screening drive?

bihar_questions.qe: Under which centrally sponsored scheme did the Union Government approve 11.18 lakh pucca houses for Bihar with an outlay of ₹13,427 crore?

bihar_questions.qe: Which state recently became the first inland state in India to export value-added Tilapia fish products to the United States under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana?
bihar_questions.qh: हाल ही में 'प्रधानमंत्री मत्स्य संपदा योजना' के तहत संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका को मूल्य-वर्धित तिलापिया (Tilapia) मछली उत्पादों का निर्यात करने वाला भारत का पहला भू-आबद्ध राज्य कौन सा बना है?

bihar_questions.qe: Which initiative was launched by the Bihar Education Department to link administrative officers directly with state model schools called 'Saraswati Vidya Niketan' for operational governance?

• Option A is Incorrect because the scheme is structured officer-wise per school, not district-wise.

bihar_questions.qe: In which state has the establishment of 'She-Marts' in every district been proposed to provide dedicated marketing avenues for women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) and Jeevika Didis?

• Option A is Incorrect because this specific marketing initiative is targeted at Bihar's Jeevika network.

bihar_questions.qe: What is the maximum financial limit for education loans provided to eligible students under the Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme?
