bihar_questions.qe: Which state government recently announced the establishment of a 'Mati Kala Board' to preserve traditional terracotta art and empower the Kumhar (Prajapati) artisan community?
bihar_questions.qh: पारंपरिक टेराकोटा कला को संरक्षित करने और कुम्हार (प्रजापति) कारीगर समुदाय को सशक्त बनाने के लिए हाल ही में किस राज्य सरकार ने 'माटी कला बोर्ड' स्थापित करने की घोषणा की है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: The Bihar government announced the establishment of a 'Mati Kala Board' (Terracotta Art Board) to preserve traditional clay art and promote the Kumhar (Prajapati) community by providing modern technology, skill training, and market access.
• Option B is Incorrect: Uttar Pradesh had previously set up a board with a similar name, but the recent announcement made in Patna pertains to Bihar.
• Option C is Incorrect: Madhya Pradesh is not the state that made this recent announcement.
• Option D is Incorrect: Rajasthan has state handicraft initiatives, but this specific policy decision belongs to Bihar.

bihar_questions.qe: To which location on the Sone River does the Bihar government propose to extend the existing JP Ganga Path into a 126-kilometer riverfront corridor?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार सरकार ने मौजूदा जेपी गंगा पथ को 126 किलोमीटर के रिवरफ्रंट कॉरिडोर के रूप में सोन नदी के किस स्थान तक विस्तारित करने का प्रस्ताव रखा है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: The Bihar government proposed extending the existing 21-km JP Ganga Path into a 126-km riverfront corridor reaching Koilwar on the Sone River with an outlay of ₹70,000 crore.
• Option A is Incorrect: Buxar is situated along the Ganga River further upstream and is not the designated terminus on the Sone River for this expansion.
• Option C is Incorrect: Mokama lies to the east of Patna along the Ganges.
• Option D is Incorrect: Digha serves as the starting point for the current operational stretch of the JP Ganga Path in Patna.

bihar_questions.qe: How many members constitute the expert committee formed by Bihar's General Administration Department to recommend comprehensive reforms in the state's examination and recruitment framework?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार के सामान्य प्रशासन विभाग द्वारा राज्य की परीक्षा और भर्ती प्रणाली में व्यापक सुधारों की सिफारिश के लिए गठित विशेषज्ञ समिति में कितने सदस्य हैं?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: The General Administration Department (GAD) of Bihar constituted a 5-member expert committee to recommend reforms across state examination boards, commissions, and recruitment agencies to prevent paper leaks and irregularities.
• Option A is Incorrect: The committee comprises 5 members, not 3.
• Option B is Incorrect: 7 members is incorrect for this specific reform panel.
• Option D is Incorrect: 9 members is incorrect.

bihar_questions.qe: Which state in India signed an agreement to develop its sovereign AI stack incorporating 'B-ONT', an ontological mind map to integrate cross-departmental citizen services?
bihar_questions.qh: किस राज्य ने हाल ही में अंतर-विभागीय नागरिक सेवाओं को एकीकृत करने वाले ऑन्कोलॉजिकल माइंड मैप 'B-ONT' को शामिल करते हुए अपना संप्रभु एआई स्टैक विकसित करने के लिए एक समझौता ज्ञापन पर हस्ताक्षर किए हैं?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Department of Information Technology, Government of Bihar, signed an MoU with ConveGenius.AI to build the state's sovereign AI stack. A key component of this project is 'B-ONT', an ontological mind map that functions as a unified knowledge graph for state schemes and citizen services.
• Option B is Incorrect because Telangana was not the state that signed this MoU for the 'B-ONT' platform.
• Option C is Incorrect because Uttar Pradesh is not associated with the 'B-ONT' AI infrastructure initiative.
• Option D is Incorrect because Odisha is not involved in this specific digital governance framework.

bihar_questions.qe: According to recent ICAR and FAO data, which state emerged as the top producer of mushrooms in India during 2023-24, contributing 12.02% of total national output?
bihar_questions.qh: हाल ही में ICAR और FAO के आंकड़ों के अनुसार, वर्ष 2023-24 के दौरान कुल राष्ट्रीय उत्पादन में 12.02% योगदान देकर भारत में कौन सा राज्य मशरूम का शीर्ष उत्पादक बनकर उभरा?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Bihar became the leading mushroom-producing state in India in 2023-24, accounting for 12.02% of the national output, followed by Odisha (9.86%) and Maharashtra (9.49%). Growth was driven by the Mushroom Kit Vitaran Scheme and Bihar Agriculture Roadmap initiatives.
• Option A is Incorrect because Maharashtra ranked third in total mushroom production with a 9.49% share.
• Option C is Incorrect because Odisha ranked second in mushroom production with a 9.86% share.
• Option D is Incorrect because Punjab is not among the top three mushroom-producing states in 2023-24.

bihar_questions.qe: The Farakka Ganga Water Sharing Treaty between India and Bangladesh, which has been in news due to concerns raised regarding siltation and lean-season water availability, was signed in 1996 for a total duration of how many years?
bihar_questions.qh: भारत और बांग्लादेश के बीच 1996 में हस्ताक्षरित फरक्का गंगा जल बंटवारा संधि, जो हाल ही में गाद जमने और शुष्क मौसम में जल की उपलब्धता से जुड़ी चिंताओं के कारण चर्चा में रही, कुल कितने वर्षों की अवधि के लिए लागू की गई थी?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the 1996 Farakka Treaty is a 30-year formula-based bilateral agreement for Ganga water sharing at Farakka Barrage during the lean season (January 1 to May 31), which is set to expire in December 2026.
• Option A is Incorrect because 15 years is not the stipulated duration of the Farakka Treaty.
• Option B is Incorrect because the treaty was signed for 30 years, not 20 years.
• Option D is Incorrect because 50 years is incorrect; the treaty expires in late 2026 after its 30-year tenure.

bihar_questions.qe: The Bihar Cabinet approved the construction of a 336-kilometre six-lane greenfield road corridor connecting which two strategic districts of the state?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार मंत्रिमंडल ने राज्य के किन दो रणनीतिक जिलों को जोड़ने वाले 336 किलोमीटर लंबे छह-लेन ग्रीनफील्ड सड़क कॉरिडोर के निर्माण को मंजूरी दी है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Bihar Cabinet approved a 336-km six-lane greenfield corridor connecting Buxar in the west to Bhagalpur in the east, spanning multiple districts including Bhojpur, Nalanda, Munger, and Jamui.
• Option A is Incorrect because Patna-Purnia is a separate proposed expressway project.
• Option B is Incorrect because Gaya and Muzaffarpur are not the terminal points of this approved 336-km greenfield road corridor.
• Option C is Incorrect because Darbhanga and Kishanganj are not connected by this specific cabinet-approved project.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the 'Mukhyamantri Balika PhD Fellowship' scheme launched by the Bihar government, what monthly financial assistance is provided to female research scholars for four years?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार सरकार द्वारा शुरू की गई 'मुख्यमंत्री बालिका पीएचडी फेलोशिप' योजना के तहत महिला शोधार्थियों को चार वर्षों के लिए प्रति माह कितनी वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की जाती है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Bihar government launched the 'Mukhyamantri Balika PhD Fellowship' scheme providing Rs 10,000 monthly fellowship for 4 years to nearly 1,000 female doctoral scholars to promote higher education and research.
• Option B is Incorrect as the stipend amount is fixed at Rs 10,000 per month, not Rs 15,000.
• Option C is Incorrect as Rs 20,000 is not the designated monthly fellowship figure under this scheme.
• Option D is Incorrect as Rs 25,000 refers to other post-doctoral or central fellowship cadres, not the Mukhyamantri Balika PhD Fellowship.

bihar_questions.qe: Which organization released the report titled 'Reimagining Skilling for Viksit Bharat', highlighting structural employment imbalances in India's higher education system?
bihar_questions.qh: भारत की उच्च शिक्षा प्रणाली में संरचनात्मक रोजगार असंतुलन को रेखांकित करने वाली 'रीइमैजिनिंग स्किलिंग फॉर विकसित भारत' शीर्षक रिपोर्ट किस संस्था द्वारा जारी की गई है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because NITI Aayog released the report titled 'Reimagining Skilling for Viksit Bharat', which highlighted that undergraduate enrolment in BA, BSc, and BCom exceeds 2 crore out of 3.4 crore total higher education students, with weak employment linkages.
• Option A is Incorrect because the report was published directly by NITI Aayog, not the Union Ministry of Education.
• Option C is Incorrect as UGC is a regulatory body, whereas NITI Aayog authored this policy report.
• Option D is Incorrect because NSDC is an execution body for skill development, not the think tank behind this strategic report.

bihar_questions.qe: According to the Bihar Industrial Investment Promotion Policy 2025, what maximum upper limit is designated for interest subventions provided to eligible large industrial units?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार औद्योगिक निवेश प्रोत्साहन नीति 2025 के अनुसार, पात्र बड़ी औद्योगिक इकाइयों को दिए जाने वाले ब्याज अनुदान (Interest Subvention) के लिए अधिकतम सीमा कितनी तय की गई है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Bihar Industrial Investment Promotion Policy 2025 offers interest subventions up to a maximum limit of Rs 40 crore, along with state GST reimbursement and virtually free land for large-scale job creators.
• Option A is Incorrect as Rs 10 crore represents lower-tier MSME support thresholds.
• Option B is Incorrect as Rs 25 crore is not the maximum cap set under this specific policy.
• Option D is Incorrect as Rs 50 crore exceeds the official subvention cap of Rs 40 crore specified by the Bihar Industries Ministry.

bihar_questions.qe: The Bihar government proposed extending the existing J.P. Ganga Path in Patna to build a 126-kilometre Marine Drive corridor connecting towards which river?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार सरकार ने पटना में मौजूदा जे.पी. गंगा पथ का विस्तार करते हुए किस नदी (कोइलवर) की ओर 126 किलोमीटर लंबा मरीन ड्राइव कॉरिडोर बनाने का प्रस्ताव रखा है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the proposed ₹70,000-crore, 126-km Ganga Marine Drive extension will stretch the existing 21-km J.P. Ganga Path in Patna towards Koilwar located on the Son River.
• Option A is Incorrect because the extension runs along the southern bank towards the Son River, not north towards the Gandak.
• Option B is Incorrect as the Koshi River flows through eastern Bihar.
• Option C is Incorrect as the extension project specifically targets Koilwar on the Son River for major regional connectivity.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the 'Sahyog Grievance Redressal Program' of the Bihar Government, what is the mandatory timeline enforced for resolving public grievances?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार सरकार के 'सहयोग जन शिकायत निवारण कार्यक्रम' के तहत जन शिकायतों के निवारण के लिए कितनी समयावधि निर्धारित की गई है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Bihar government's 'Sahyog Grievance Redressal Program' has enforced a strict 30-day deadline for public grievance resolution, achieving a high resolution rate.
• Option A is Incorrect because 15 days is shorter than the stipulated limit.
• Option C is Incorrect because 45 days exceeds the official target window.
• Option D is Incorrect because 60 days is not the prescribed timeframe for this initiative.

bihar_questions.qe: In which year was the Centrally Sponsored 'Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises' (PMFME) Scheme launched under the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan?
bihar_questions.qh: आत्मनिर्भर भारत अभियान के तहत केंद्र प्रायोजित 'प्रधानमंत्री सूक्ष्म खाद्य उद्योग उन्नयन योजना' (PMFME) किस वर्ष शुरू की गई थी?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the PMFME Scheme was launched in 2020 by the Ministry of Food Processing Industries as part of the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan to support unorganised micro food processing enterprises.
• Option A is Incorrect because the scheme was not active in 2018.
• Option B is Incorrect because 2019 predates the Atmanirbhar Bharat package announcement.
• Option D is Incorrect because 2022 is not the launch year of the scheme.

bihar_questions.qe: Which digital platform has been established for media registration under the Press and Registration of Periodicals (PRP) Act, 2023?
bihar_questions.qh: प्रेस और पत्र-पत्रिका पंजीकरण (PRP) अधिनियम, 2023 के तहत मीडिया पंजीकरण के लिए किस डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म की स्थापना की गई है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the 'Press Sewa Portal' is the official online portal developed for seamless digital processing of media registration under the Press and Registration of Periodicals (PRP) Act, 2023.
• Option A is Incorrect because it is a generic non-official name.
• Option C is Incorrect because Patrika Sewa Hub is not the statutory portal name.
• Option D is Incorrect because National Press Digital Gateway is not the designated application interface under the 2023 Act.
